question: How much higher the average intrinsic value is for trades using the feeling-lucky strategy compared to those using the momentum strategy under long-side trades?
sql:
SELECT 
  AVG(CASE WHEN t.TargetCompID LIKE 'LUCKY%' THEN (t.LastPx - t.StrikePrice) * t.Quantity ELSE NULL END) 
  - 
  AVG(CASE WHEN t.TargetCompID LIKE 'MOMO%' THEN (t.LastPx - t.StrikePrice) * t.Quantity ELSE NULL END) AS difference
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report` t, UNNEST(t.Sides) AS side
WHERE side.Side = 'LONG'
